title: The fact guard does not take the template's own phone, mailbox, street, price or year as evidence; past the drop cap the worst lines still go
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/brief-guard.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/brief-wordpress.test.mjs

S2: Record the exit code, the '# tests', '# pass', '# fail' lines and the result of each case whose name starts with: "a fact the slot’s own sample carries is not evidence: only what the customer said is"; "a line that keeps the template's own fact is not written: it is asked again, and the honest line goes in"; "more lines with no honest replacement than may be taken off: the ones naming the template’s company go first, never none".
expect: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (at least 69).

Every named case is 'ok' (none 'not ok', none '# SKIP'): ungrounded() accepts a fact only from the brief, never from the slot's own sample; a WordPress line that keeps the template's fact is asked again and the honest line goes in; past MAX_DROPS (30) lines with no honest replacement the 30 naming the template's company or repeating its facts are taken off first, never none.
evidence: Ledger L09, 05/10/2026 (code reading guard.js): a line the model rewrote around the template's own hotline or mailbox passed the guard because the fact was in the slot's sample; review then found the 30-drop cap all-or-nothing. Reds 927c4259a, d05594467; fixes 6b0b0c8d1, e040deb77.
fence: Only facts of the brief count, for phones, emails, streets, prices and years alike.

tests: a fact the slot’s own sample carries is not evidence: only what the customer said is
a line that keeps the template's own fact is not written: it is asked again, and the honest line goes in
more lines with no honest replacement than may be taken off: the ones naming the template’s company go first, never none
